raw.description: 战斗阶段结束时，若自身没有音符则获得1分强音，若自身拥有中音则获得1分弱音|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，若自身没有[color=#f35555]音符[/color]则获得1分[color=#f35555]强音[/color]，若自身拥有[color=#f35555]中音[/color]则获得1分[color=#f35555]弱音[/color]

review.rationale: Q001满4后任何来源新音符都忽略，原音符顺序序号不变，不触删除/消费；原自然音符与天在此当前强化继续完整执行。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 战阶无音符强音、有中音弱音；满4忽略新授，不移动原序列、不增序号、不触音符删除或消费、不开额外免疫。

success.name: 4895全部17招有序编译、64种子基础与真实2082原生逐招释放，首次无音符与单次资源、满4及恢复计量按已答执行
success.assertion: test('4895全部17招有序编译、64种子基础与真实2082原生逐招释放，首次无音符与单次资源、满4及恢复计量按已答执行',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4895 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].sourceHash,'f9cab88');assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].partial,false);assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4895真实2082空音符战阶末获得强音，有中音才追加弱音，原生2450三种获得独立于免异，保持先后顺序
success.assertion: test('4895真实2082空音符战阶末获得强音，有中音才追加弱音，原生2450三种获得独立于免异，保持先后顺序',()=>{const empty=make({move:38359,soul:true});turn(empty,38359,null);assert.deepEqual(values(empty),[3]);for(const [move,want]of[[29326,[3]],[29327,[1]],[38354,[2,1]]]){const s=make({move,index:move===29326||move===29327?0:1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=3;turn(s,move,null);assert.deepEqual(values(s),want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);}const absent=prepareNotes(make({move:38359,soul:true}),[1,3]);turn(absent,38359,null);assert.deepEqual(values(absent),[1,3]);});

success.name: 4895真实自然谱序列：战阶强音、嘒鸣弱音、施洗中音与战阶弱音，歌不落依次消费强弱中弱得到天在此及三种当前免疫
success.assertion: test('4895真实自然谱序列：战阶强音、嘒鸣弱音、施洗中音与战阶弱音，歌不落依次消费强弱中弱得到天在此及三种当前免疫',()=>{const s=make({move:38359,soul:true,loadout:[38359,29327,38354,38355,29328]});turn(s,38359,null);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[3]);turn(s,29327,null);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[3,1]);turn(s,38354,null);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[3,1,2,1]);turn(s,29328,null);assert.equal(score(s).heaven,1);assert.equal(score(s).heavenGains,1);assert.deepEqual(score(s).events.filter(e=>e.event==='consume').map(e=>e.value),[3,1,2,1]);assert.deepEqual(values(s),[3]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(score(s).executionImmunity.length,2);});

success.assertion: test('4895/1798下回合实际未用攻击才尝试麻痹，麻痹未触发授次属性失效，控制未用与药剂符合条件、已经用但MISS仍为攻击',()=>{for(const mode of['status','attack','miss','potion','control','immune','noPP']){const s=make({...row(1798),loadout:[38364,38359,38361,38355,29328]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=s.round;if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}const enemy=['attack','miss','control','noPP'].includes(mode)?10127:20117;const play=()=>turn(s,38359,mode==='potion'?null:enemy);if(mode==='noPP')observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.t.pp[key(enemy)]=0;},play);else play();assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],!['attack','miss','immune'].includes(mode));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextStatusInvalid??0,mode==='immune'?1:0);}});

success.name: 4895/1156实际击败才回满HP与所有PP，技能禁疗只挡HP；547双方独立烧伤4且免疫可各自失败，191授回合反弹
success.assertion: test('4895/1156实际击败才回满HP与所有PP，技能禁疗只挡HP；547双方独立烧伤4且免疫可各自失败，191授回合反弹',()=>{for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1156),hp:1000,targetHp:1});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ban?1000:9000);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}for(const side of[-1,0,1]){const s=make(row(547));if(side>=0)s.fighters[side].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(let i=0;i<2;i++)assert.equal(!!s.fighters[i].ailments['烧伤'],i!==side);if(side<0){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],4);}}const r=make(row(191));r.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(r));assert.equal(r.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(r.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.ok(r.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);});

success.assertion: test('4895全部17招有序编译、64种子基础与真实2082原生逐招释放，首次无音符与单次资源、满4及恢复计量按已答执行',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4895 base '+m.id);}assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].sourceHash,'f9cab88');assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2082].partial,false);assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4895真实2082空音符战阶末获得强音，有中音才追加弱音，原生2450三种获得独立于免异，保持先后顺序
success.assertion: test('4895真实2082空音符战阶末获得强音，有中音才追加弱音，原生2450三种获得独立于免异，保持先后顺序',()=>{const empty=make({move:38359,soul:true});turn(empty,38359,null);assert.deepEqual(values(empty),[3]);for(const [move,want]of[[29326,[3]],[29327,[1]],[38354,[2,1]]]){const s=make({move,index:move===29326||move===29327?0:1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=3;turn(s,move,null);assert.deepEqual(values(s),want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);}const absent=prepareNotes(make({move:38359,soul:true}),[1,3]);turn(absent,38359,null);assert.deepEqual(values(absent),[1,3]);});

success.name: 4895/2450获得、2448删除、2449消耗均须技能生效，整招无效不修改原音符；控制未用也不消费，零伤命中仍能施洗获得中音

success.assertion: test('4895/993麻痹目标全二否则全一，717低于半体只双回复不双粉且免伤仍理论回复，1823麻痹失败焚烬再失败才对手双攻各弱2，619敌下两回先制负2',()=>{for(const paralyzed of[false,true]){const s=make(row(993));if(paralyzed)s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],paralyzed?2:1);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(717),hp:1000});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,7000);}for(const charges of[0,1,2]){const s=make(row(1823));s.fighters[1].counts.immune=charges;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],charges===0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],charges===1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,charges===2?-2:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,charges===2?-2:0);}const a=make({...row(619),loadout:[29327,38359,38361,38355,29328]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,38359,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?-2:0);}});

success.name: 4895/2448未烧伤不删，有烧伤删除强音清敌回合并臣服，删除弱音清强并使用结束理论吸取；删除不是消耗不授免疫
success.assertion: test('4895/2448未烧伤不删，有烧伤删除强音清敌回合并臣服，删除弱音清强并使用结束理论吸取；删除不是消耗不授免疫',()=>{const none=prepareNotes(make({move:38355,index:0,hp:1000}),[3,1]);turn(none,38355,null);assert.deepEqual(values(none),[3,1]);const s=prepareNotes(make({move:38355,index:0,hp:1000}),[3,1]);s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;let afterHitHP,afterUseHP;const engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(p,o,c){const out=engine.run(p,o,c);if(c.a.side===0&&p==='afterHit')afterHitHP=c.a.hp;if(c.a.side===0&&p==='afterUse')afterUseHP=c.a.hp;return out;}};try{turn(s,38355,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.deepEqual(values(s),[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['臣服']);assert.equal(afterHitHP,1000);assert.equal(afterUseHP,4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify??0,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,0);assert.equal(score(s).executionImmunity?.length??0,0);});

success.name: 4895/2448中音清护盾护罩剩余量50%真实百分比伤害，保持真实删除而非消费；目标已死不凭空附伤

instance.description: 恢复自身所有技能的PP值，每恢复所有技能7点，令对手全属性-1

raw.description: 若自身处于烧伤状态则删除自身的所有音符；恢复自身所有技能的PP值，每恢复所有技能7点，令对手全属性-1；打出致命一击时威力提升100%；下次击败对手时，令对方下只出战精灵麻痹

metadata.template: 恢复自身所有技能的PP值，每恢复所有技能{0}点，令对手全属性-{1}

review.rationale: Q003按本次实际各槽恢复PP总和除7取整，每档全弱1，余数当次舍弃；累计字段只保留审计总量，不作为跨次阈值。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回复所有技能至各自真实PP上限，按本次实际总回复floor(total/7)全属性下降，余数不累计；免弱挡能力下降不挡PP回复，技能回复封锁导致实际0和零档。

success.name: 4895/2453真实恢复PP不足7零档与封PP回复，跨槽恢复总和按本次每7一档弱化；2454实际暴击威力300否则150，2162下只麻痹不提前加当前敌
success.assertion: test('4895/2453真实恢复PP不足7零档与封PP回复，跨槽恢复总和按本次每7一档弱化；2454实际暴击威力300否则150，2162下只麻痹不提前加当前敌',()=>{const s=make(row(2453));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.score4895.ppRestoreEvents[0].restored,1);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],0);const q=make(row(2453));for(const k of q.fighters[0].moves)if(k!==key(q.auditMoveId))q.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;turn(q,q.auditMoveId,null);const tiers=Math.floor(q.fighters[0].soulState.score4895.ppRestoreEvents[0].restored/7);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(q.fighters[1].stages[k],Math.max(-6,-tiers));const blocked=make(row(2453));for(const k of blocked.fighters[0].moves)blocked.fighters[0].pp[k]=k===key(blocked.auditMoveId)?2:0;blocked.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;timer(blocked,1,'机械领域',{fraction:.6});turn(blocked,blocked.auditMoveId,null);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(blocked.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(blocked.fighters[0].pp[key(blocked.auditMoveId)],1);assert.equal(blocked.fighters[0].soulState.score4895.ppRestoredTotal,0);for(const crit of[false,true]){const a=make(row(2454));if(crit)timer(a,0,'必定暴击');assert.equal(power(()=>turn(a)),crit?300:150);}const future=make({...row(2162),targetHp:1});turn(future,future.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4895/1861整招无效才清敌回合并沉默3，控制未用不执行补偿，零伤命中不执行补偿且原音符不被无效技能消耗',()=>{for(const mode of['invalid','control','valid']){const s=prepareNotes(make({move:29328,index:1}),[3,1]);if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=2;turn(s,29328,20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],mode==='invalid');if(mode==='invalid')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默'],3);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.score4895.notes.map(x=>x.value),[3,1]);}});
